name: warp-agent-mcp
description: MCP server for the Warp freight API. Quote, book, and track LTL, FTL, cargo van, and box-truck shipments from Claude Desktop, Cursor, Claude Code, or any MCP-compatible AI agent.
long_description:
26 tools covering the full freight booking lifecycle:

- **Mode compare** — the one call for "what's the cheapest way to ship this?": prices every mode the load can legally ride (cargo van, box truck, LTL, FTL) in parallel and returns the winning mode, a bookable quote id, and the cost-vs-transit trade-off already calculated
- **Quote** — instant pricing for cargo van (1-3 pallets), box truck (1-12 pallets), full truckload (53' dry van), and LTL; LTL splits the fast Warp rate from the 30+ carrier market comparison so you see a price in ~1-2s
- **Batch** — price an entire spreadsheet of lanes in one call, then confirm N quoted lanes in one batch book, each rendered as a single card
- **Multi-stop** — quote and book one truck across 3+ stops
- **Book** — book any quote with pickup + delivery addresses; card charged automatically via Stripe; charge auto-refunded if booking fails
- **Track** — real-time shipment status and full event timeline
- **Manage** — list bookings and quotes, lane history, invoices, BOLs and PODs, saved locations and load templates
- **Auth** — in-chat login via `warp_login`; no portal visit required

All tools require a Warp account. Sign up free at wearewarp.com or use the companion `@warpfreight/cli-agent` package which auto-provisions an account and wires this MCP into every detected AI client.

tools.name: van_quote
tools.description: Quote a cargo van shipment (1-3 pallets, firm price, 15-min expiry)

tools.name: box_truck_quote
tools.description: Quote a 26' box truck shipment (1-12 pallets, firm price, 15-min expiry)

tools.name: ftl_quote
tools.description: Quote a full truckload (53' dry van)

tools.name: ltl_quote
tools.description: Quote an LTL shipment — returns Warp's all-inclusive rate FAST (~1-2s) so the user sees a price immediately

tools.name: ltl_market_options
tools.description: Multi-carrier LTL comparison — returns 30+ carrier rates ranked by price (slow, ~15s)

tools.name: compare_modes
tools.description: THE ONE CALL for "what's the cheapest/best way to ship this?"

tools.name: batch_quote
tools.description: Price MANY lanes in ONE call (parallel, ~1-3s for typical spreadsheets)

tools.name: book
tools.description: Book a quoted shipment using any quote_id or option id returned from a quote tool (Warp or market carrier)

tools.name: batch_book
tools.description: Book MANY already-quoted lanes in ONE call (sequential, one card charge per row)

tools.name: multistop_quote
tools.description: Quote a multi-stop FTL route: ONE truck visits 3+ stops in order (first pickup → intermediate stops → final delivery)

tools.name: multistop_book
tools.description: Book a multi-stop FTL route quoted by multistop_quote

tools.name: track
tools.description: Track a shipment by ID or tracking number

tools.name: lane_history
tools.description: Get shipping history for your lanes (past shipments, last consignee, counts)

tools.name: list_bookings
tools.description: List recent bookings for this API key, newest first

tools.name: status
tools.description: Check Warp API health and version

tools.name: events
tools.description: Get the full tracking event history for a shipment (timeline of pickups, in-transit updates, deliveries)

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: Retrieve the invoice for a delivered shipment (line items, taxes, payment status)

tools.name: get_documents
tools.description: List shipment documents (BOL, POD, customs forms, etc.)

tools.name: quote_history
tools.description: List your recent freight quotes (LTL, van, box truck, FTL) from all sessions

tools.name: login
tools.description: Log in to Warp with email and password

tools.name: payment_status
tools.description: Check if the current Warp account has a payment method on file

tools.name: analytics
tools.description: Show bookings analytics: total revenue, shipment count, breakdown by source (mcp vs cli)

tools.name: locations
tools.description: List the agent's saved pickup/delivery locations (addresses Warp has on file for this account), so you can reuse them when booking instead of re-typing addresses

tools.name: load_templates
tools.description: List the agent's saved load templates — reusable shipment configs (name, dims, weight, commodity)

tools.name: save_load_template
tools.description: Save a reusable load template (a named shipment config) so it can be recalled for repeat lanes

tools.name: delete_load_template
tools.description: Delete a saved load template by its id (starts with lt_)
